summary: Catalogue-wide source-contract screen of 218 roadmaps and 2006 stage records at be09b0fb85faab7fc6a8646e9f524140cfa0df2e, continuing PR #538. Six incoming links (four retained and two added), four overlaps (three retained and one rescope proposal), and 218 examined records.
